notation.i: immediately preceding official WIG information session
notation.v[k]: split_adjusted_volume on official session k, usable only when volume_usable_for_relative_volume=true
notation.W[k]: validated WIG close on official session k
notation.exact_window: Every stated official-session observation must exist and be usable; no shortened window, forward fill, or endpoint substitution.
notation.xrank: average-tie ascending rank divided by the eligible member count n; range [1/n,1]

implementation_fingerprint_policy: D0 fingerprints this registry as a whole. D1 must record SHA-256 code fingerprints for each implemented formula and shared timing/eligibility pipeline, prove fixture equivalence to this registry, and freeze them before real predictive execution.
